description: Manage a Google Ads campaign the customer created here: pause it, change its daily budget, or add negative keywords. Activation and bid changes are not available from chat (the customer approves spend on the Ads page).

campaignId.description: Google Ads campaign ID to modify

negativeKeywords.description: Negative keywords to add (required if action is ADD_NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS)

newDailyBudgetCents.description: New daily budget in cents (required if action is UPDATE_BUDGET)

name: google_ads_manage_campaign
title: Manage Google Ads Campaign
